subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should the shipped `llm_input` and `llm_output` observation hooks become a cross-runner interception API, and which modifier fields must every supported harness guarantee?
rationale: This changes a public plugin compatibility and security boundary, while the embedded, CLI, and Codex app-server runners have different mutation capabilities; code inspection cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Uniform narrow contract
options.body: Guarantee only modifier fields every intended runner can safely consume, and defer runner-specific powers to separate APIs.

options.title: Capability-specific contract
options.body: Expose explicit runner capability metadata and document how unsupported modifier fields are handled.

options.title: Separate interception hooks
options.body: Keep the existing hooks observational and introduce distinct modifying hooks after product and security approval.

recommendation.title: Uniform narrow contract
recommendation.body: Guarantee only modifier fields every intended runner can safely consume, and defer runner-specific powers to separate APIs.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original public hook contract and are the strongest available history-backed owner for deciding whether its semantics may change.
